title: Demo: 3D Meta Hologram Calls on Meta VR Glasses

author: CNET
description:
Imagine walking around doing chores while on a phone call, but all the person you’re talking to sees is you chatting with them normally. 

At Meta Connect 2026, we got a live demonstration of how phone calls and WhatsApp calls will look like with Meta’s photorealistic Hologram avatars coming to Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses. Even if you don’t have a pair of Display glasses, you’ll be able to see the caller’s Hologram on your phone. #metaconnect #metaglasses #metahologram #vr #allthingsmobile
